notes: An anime melee fighting game — M1 combos, three special moves, a training dummy — which is Action, and the genre note is explicit that a Roblox anime fighter is picturing the Battlegrounds layout. The answers cap the map at a few dense Tokyo blocks fought at street level, so the bounded single-level combat space is the shape rather than a roaming city or a stacked arena; nothing in the prompt says the fight uses rooftops or overhangs, so I stayed off P2. Dropped the preset's hazard-kill because ring-out pits contradict a dense city street grid, and added settlement-density for the blocks and npc-population for the Yellow Noob dummy. The answers state real enterable doors with simple interiors on a few key buildings, so building-interior and its P3 are earned rather than assumed.
